== Strategy ==

this deck is pretty good.

it has plenty of jedi to keep control of your opponent, some nice dueling cards, a ok fleet and politics to control the senate.  What kills your opponent is destiny.  I have a lot of high destinies in this deck.  It has only lost a couple of times.  it works by i start off getting my characters with simi low destiny and get them armed with their weapons using sai' torr kal fas's virtual game text.  i use politics in the senate to win battles easily there and use the senators' game text that helps me out in other battles.  the jedi with their lightsabers help me out in battles and in modifying force drains heavily at sites.  I also try to keep my high destiny in my deck and my low destiny out of it using threepio with his parts's showing game text and i finaally, use security control to get my docking bays out so i can docking bay transit whenever need it.  that is my updated stradegy for my deck.
